points.description: States that the water on the floor has a much larger surface area (exposed to air) than the water in the cup, which has a smaller surface area, so more evaporation occurs from the floor. Equivalent wording accepted.

levels.says: Mentions only that surface area matters or that the floor water has a larger surface area, without contrasting it with the cup's smaller surface area.

rubric.notes: Full mark for contrasting the larger surface area of water on the floor with the smaller surface area in the cup. Half mark for mentioning surface area only partially. No marks for other explanations, such as temperature or wiping, without surface area.
